newsitem.title: CANADA: Renaissance files C$400 mln debt issue.
newsitem.headline: Renaissance files C$400 mln debt issue.

text.p: Renaissance Energy Ltd said on Monday it filed a preliminary short-form prospectus for the issue of up to C$400 million of medium-term notes to be issued from time to time until December 1998.
Renaissance said net proceeds would be added to general funds and applied to repay commercial paper borrowings and bank loans.
The company said some of the funds would also go to its capital spending program.
Renaissance said it intended to offer up to C$200 million of the notes in the first quarter of 1997 and, after that, in tranches as required by company operations.
The issued notes were to be unsecured and ranked the same as other Renaissance debt, he said.
The company's senior unsecured debt was rated A (high) with a positive outlook by Canadian Bond Rating Service and A (high) with a stable outlook by Dominion Bond Rating Service.
Rnaissance retained TD Securities, RBC Domion Securities, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities and Nesbitt Burns as agents for the issue in Canada.
